description: 방송미디어통신위원회_스마트폰 이용행태 조사 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 방송미디어통신위원회. 2015년부터 2025년까지 해마다 스마트폰의 일일 이용시간(통화시간 제외)과 월 이용요금, 스마트폰 기능별 중요도(2015년~2024년), 미디어 기능 이용 빈도(2025년부터 스마트폰 기능별 중요도 문항이 조사에서 빠지게 되어 스마트폰 미디어 기능 이용 빈도로 대체되어 제공)를 조사하여 작성한 통계입... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 방송미디어통신위원회. Its tags are 스마트폰, 이용시간, 이용요금, 이용행태, 디지털격차. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
